page.layout: One page of text: running head at top centre; verse in one column with short headings; a note fragment at the lower right edge; marginal show-through and stains ignored.

main_text.p:
Doctrina molles tingat annos, cautior
Juventa rectos tramites volet sequi,
Prodesse cunctis, & nocere neminì.
main_text.head: SARA.
main_text.p:
Proba genitricis officio fungar, neque
Exempla sequar matrum nimis quæ blandula
Nihil recusant liberis, verùm annuunt
Quicquid ferociens libido pàruulis
Pectoribus illorum expetit, nec datus
Vesaniam audent insitam retundere.
Tantùm licere quæ Deus probat finam,
Et cuncta quæ vetat docebo mox meum
Vitare Isacum. Sed bono messpes iubet
Animo esse: nam cælestis illum qui Pater
Portare me volùit sterili aluo, & aridis
Lactare mammis filium hunc fidus bonas
Vbique deducet per orbitas comes.
main_text.head: Sathanas cucullatus.
main_text.p:
Non Vllus orbe cernitur toto locus,
Quem non pererrans & sque lasirem, nec labor,
Nec cura lassat inquies, dum cogere
Mortale quaro sub meum ingum genus.
Fulgente Olympo regna seruent Cælites:
Modo sunum me terra principem colat.
Cælo phalanges Angelorum promptius
Dei capessant iussa summi dum meis
Subiecta tellus imperiis parens tremat.

page.notes: The "Ca" at the lower right is the start of a catchword or signature cut off by the edge; the initial verse lines are italic throughout. Several words in the verse are doubtful due to the scan (e.g. "blandula", "Isacum", "sub", "Vllus"), and the left margin carries only stains and show-through, not transcribed.
